summary.text: Yellow Bell Tribe is a super tribe inside Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven whose tribe leader and first elder both have rank eight cultivation.

claims.text: At Moon Field Slope before the Myriad Tribes Ceremony, nearby leaders warn Lu Tong Lan that Fire Blend Tribe Leader Jiao Huo has gone over to Yellow Bell Tribe. They call Yellow Bell Tribe a super tribe whose tribe leader and first elder both have rank eight cultivation. Hei Lou Lan judges that truly top-tier forces are still existences like Yellow Bell Tribe, and that Jiao Huo used his tribe’s weakness as an excuse to get close to it.

During the Myriad Tribes Ceremony, Yellow Bell Tribe offers a vast heavenly sparrow group, ten sight plundering vines, and one outsider as tribute. The strongest forces like Yellow Bell Tribe offer large amounts of ancient desolate beasts and plants, or even several immemorial desolate beasts and plants. Outsiders executed as tribute are Gu Immortals of at least rank seven; those Yellow Bell Tribe executes are even rank eight Gu Immortals.

Fire Blend Tribe loses many elders half a year earlier, grows weaker, and joins Yellow Bell Tribe as a subsidiary force. Yellow Bell Tribe has enemies of its own. As the myriad tribes fight, even a super force like Yellow Bell Tribe shows signs of downfall before Myriad Life Road appears.

On Myriad Life Road, Yellow Bell Tribe Leader arrives and tells Hei Lou Lan that Sacred Child is qualified to cooperate. He proposes that the remaining immortals take Immortal Gu and immortal materials in turns, with anyone who ignores the rules becoming everyone’s enemy, because the road appears only once every ten thousand years. He later takes quantity change Gu on his turn, recovers strength to an extent, and tries to recruit a young rank seven Gu Immortal who rejects him. When only Hei Lou Lan, Yellow Bell Tribe Leader, and that rank seven remain, he stakes his life to kill a Predicament guarding ability Gu.

After the three kill that Predicament, Yellow Bell Tribe Leader’s golden bell totem is greatly damaged. Lying on the ground, he claims ability Gu and says he will owe Hei Lou Lan and the rank seven a favor whether or not they join Yellow Bell Tribe. The rank seven snatches ability Gu into his immortal aperture. Yellow Bell Tribe Leader coughs blood, falls unconscious, and falls from the heavenly road.
